race.comment: SHOGUN CHIKARA (5) was solid in the market and did a fine job on debut last start over 1516m at Gawler, racing on the speed and holding on well for a close second. Maps beautifully up on the speed again from an ideal draw and with some natural improvement to come he can go one better. WILLEBOB (7) went close three back over 1300m at Balaklava but has been safely held in the subsequent runs over 1400m. Lacking a turn of foot over those trips which suggests the step up to a mile could be what the doctor ordered now. FULLHEADOFSTEAM (1) has had plenty of chances and is not living up to recent his recent SP profile. Led for the judge but couldn't maintain the momentum as $2.50 favourite most recently over 1350m at Port Lincoln. Probably looking for more ground so can improve. EMPRESS OF KIRK (11) found the line with purpose over 1350m at Strathalbyn last time and has more improvement to come at just her third start. Market watch on ROCKIN' DEE FOX (4) first-up for a new trainer.
